notes: Reviewed against native source crops, full inventories and words. The limits guard body size while preserving optical differences, overshoot and distinct serif shapes.

rules.notes: Reviewed ordinary cap bodies, round overshoot and optical-size variation; preserve the source widths and serif treatment.
Observed or separately labelled reconstructed Q tail extends below the cap baseline.
Reviewed lining figures from several optical sizes. Smaller cuts have modestly lower tops and deeper rounded feet; do not equalise them merely to match a nominal box.
Historical lowercase bodies with optical-size differences; inferred x/z/w follow the documented source vocabulary.
Observed or reconstructed ascenders and i dot align with the ordinary cap region.
Observed or new f rises above the lowercase body; curved hooks may overshoot ordinary ascenders.
Observed GPO 1897 48-point j has a shorter hooked descender; retain its dot and uniform source scale.
Observed q/p or explicit derivatives retain the lowercase bowl and descending stem.
Observed or inferred y retains a descending diagonal hook independently of the body height.
Observed t rises above the lowercase body and below the capital line.
Observed 12-point g has a shallow double-storey descender; preserve this historical optical cut.
